purpose: Post-result engineering deployment and cost audit, not an independent accuracy confirmation
selection: Evenly spaced indices among frozen evaluation query list; no selection by correctness
ranking: FP32 single-query dot products and stable descending full sort; original global gallery ID tie order
archive_implementation: One full archived-gallery score vector and sort; active top10 obtained by masking that order; no redundant active-gallery dot product
gpu_budget: 16 unique images, batch1, two warmups plus three passes per dataset; existing CAMP no training, expected <5 minutes, peak below 6GiB
memory: Explicit ndarray payload and Windows process current/peak working set; process peak includes initialization; neither is total system memory
cache_scope: Cache may be used only for an exactly identified previously processed query. Cold keys must fail. Per-query cache does not support unseen queries.
new_query_scope: Runtime reads only query descriptors/images, archived gallery descriptors and active IDs. No previous winner/SU, ground-truth locations or correctness labels.
limits: Queries are operationally replayed without historical query state, not newly acquired independent test data
Warm local timing is descriptive; no hard realtime guarantee
Exact float near-ties may differ across single-query and original block scoring; all disagreements reported
Deleted candidates never returned as active predictions
No thresholds fitted; no original results overwritten
